why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Connect a wallet on the points page Open the SwarmBase points page and use a browser wallet such as MetaMask. If the page reports the wrong network, switch the wallet to opBNB.
2 Step 2 : Register the wallet on-chain Use the Register Now action once per wallet. Registration activates the SwarmScore and unlocks the other actions.
3 Step 3 : Check in every 24 hours Press Check In Today each day to extend your streak; daily points rise as the streak continues.

4 Step 4 : Mint a Pioneer badge, then higher tiers Any registered wallet can mint the Pioneer badge, and Builder needs a SwarmScore of at least 1,000. OG needs a SwarmScore of 5,000 or more and a wallet registered for at least 14 days, and only 5,000 will ever be minted.
5 Step 5 : Share your invite link Send your personal invite link to others on the points page . Each wallet that registers through it adds points to your score.
6 Step 6 : Follow the token launch phase Watch the roadmap on the SwarmBase homepage for the community distribution that follows the TGE snapshot.
